# 🔴 Do not edit the files in this directory

`book/chapters/` is the **downstream promoted copy** of the manuscript. Treat it as generated output.

**Write in `book/drafts/chapters/` instead.** That is the live manuscript. The author reviews and
approves changes in the local review app, which writes into the drafts track. Anything edited here is
not reviewed and will be overwritten or silently diverge.
